noscriptBody: This music guessing game uses the Web Audio API to play clips and run the game in real time. Please enable JavaScript in your browser settings to play.
noscriptHint: ต้องเปิด JavaScript เพื่อเล่นเกม

howToPlay.a: Press play to hear a short snippet of a song, then type the title you think it is. Not sure yet? Unlock a longer clip, but the less you hear, the more you score.

daily.a: The same set of songs for every player each day, resetting on Thailand time (UTC+7). Scores are verified on the server and ranked on a daily leaderboard.

cost.q: Do I need an account or to pay?
cost.a: No. BeatDrop is free to play in your browser, with no account required.

thaiSongs.a: Yes. BeatDrop has both Thai and international songs, and you can play by category, artist, genre or release year.
